text:
marta: ping finance  Received invoice from BerlinAI GmbH charging 19% DE VAT. Their VAT ID looks short: DE81234567 (8 digits) but German VAT IDs are typically 9 digits after DE. Invoice: 
```
Vendor: BerlinAI GmbH
VAT: DE81234567
Invoice: BA-2026-441
Net: 8,400 EUR
VAT 19%: 1,596 EUR
Total: 9,996 EUR
```
Link: https://vendors.example.com/berlinai/invoice/BA-2026-441

jon: Quick check: German VAT (USt-IdNr) format is DE followed by 9 digits. This one is 8 digits, so likely malformed. If it's B2B within EU, reverse charge applies when buyer is VAT-registered. Do we have a German VAT ID on file for Redwood?

ap-bot: (automated) Redwood VAT IDs: EU123456789 (company), DE registration not present. Vendor onboarding record: VAT ID provided but not validated.

tax-ops: Two tracks: 1) If vendor is actually a German supplier and should charge VAT, they must provide correct USt-IdNr or VAT registration evidence. 2) If supply is cross-border B2B and supplier is not taxable in Germany (e.g., OSS or digital marketplace), treatment can vary. Ask for VAT certificate or German Handelsregister extract. Also ask them to indicate if this is an intra-community supply or local taxable sale.

marta: Operational ask: Can AP hold the VAT amount and pay net? We have a recurring contract with them for model hosting.

jon: Prefer asking for corrected invoice referencing reverse charge or correct VAT number. For recurring, we should get clean docs now to avoid future headaches.

legal: If vendor insists invoice is correct, request a signed statement explaining legal basis and include indemnity language. Also check whether our place of supply rules mean they correctly charged German VAT (if services performed in DE).

tax-ops: Suggested reply text: "Please provide a copy of your German VAT registration (USt-IdNr) that validates on VIES or issue a corrected invoice without German VAT referencing 'reverse charge' and including our VAT ID EU123456789. If you cannot provide evidence, we will pay the net amount and hold the VAT element in suspense pending validation."

marta: I'll send that and CC legal. If they push for immediate gross-up we escalate.

ap-bot: (automated) Payment hold flag set: vendor_verification_required. AP note: do not release VAT line until vendor docs received.

marta: Thanks. I'll update the ticket with their reply. :pray:
